content.about: The Marshall Islands is a Pacific nation of 29 coral atolls. It is very low-lying. Bikini Atoll was used for nuclear tests. Its people navigated with stick charts.

standout.text: Kwajalein is one of the largest coral atolls in the world.

didYouKnow: Bikini Atoll gave its name to the swimsuit.
Its average height is about 2 m.
